title: Socket path /run/user/{uid} hardcoded, so the daemon cannot start on macOS
description:
The workspace now COMPILES for aarch64-apple-darwin with zero warnings (compiler-verified via cargo check --target, not argued). It still cannot RUN there.

/run/user/{uid}/persona/workload.sock is built with no cfg in three places:
  personad/src/main.rs:54
  persona/src/main.rs:58
  persona-nmh/src/main.rs:63

macOS has no /run/user/{uid}, and persona-grpc/src/server.rs:24 calls create_dir_all(parent) on that path, which cannot succeed there.

This contradicts documentation the project already ships. README.md's Architecture section and SPEC-HIA.md's Platform Support section both state the macOS socket lives at $TMPDIR/persona/workload.sock, and the repo ships launchd/personal.atwood.persona.plist. So macOS is a declared target, the units exist, the code compiles for it, and the daemon still cannot bind.

Distinct from persona-5s4b.109, which was the compile break and is fixed. This is the runtime gap behind it, invisible until the compile break was cleared.

Fix: derive the socket path per platform rather than formatting one string. Linux /run/user/{uid} (or /tmp/persona-{uid} without systemd, per README), macOS $TMPDIR/persona, Windows named pipe. It belongs in one place; persona-5s4b.12 already tracks the duplication across three binaries, so the two should be fixed together.

Found by the workflow's macOS cross-target verification lens after the compile fix landed.
notes:
Verified on real hardware (macOS 26.6.2, mark-mac) after closure, not just by cross-compile:
  confstr(_CS_DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR) -> /var/folders/pg/.../T/  (49 bytes)
  assembled socket path 70 bytes, sun_path limit 104, 34 spare
  UnixListener::bind at that path SUCCEEDED
  temp dir is drwx------ owned by the user
  confstr identical with TMPDIR set / unset / overridden to /tmp, while both $TMPDIR and std::env::temp_dir() followed the override to /tmp
The last line matters: the review's soft flag calling the 20-line FFI branch over-engineered next to std::env::temp_dir() is disproved. temp_dir() honours TMPDIR, so a client with it overridden would look in /tmp while the daemon listens in /var/folders.
close_reason: Fixed in ceea8bd. Single persona_grpc::socket::workload_socket_path() helper; all four call sites use it, three hand-formatted copies deleted. Also fixed two defects found in review: empty XDG_RUNTIME_DIR yielding a relative path, and an unsafe /tmp fallback directory. Tests 37 -> 48, none modified.
